effects.l1: The hand that mends: + Earth to repair or restoration Tests.
effects.l2: The hand that creates: + Tao level to Tests creating an object or work of art.
effects.l3: The hand that acts: halve the Interval and Difficulty Threshold of creative Continuous Tests.
effects.l4: The hand of inspiration: imbue a creation with an exceptional quality (usually up to +2), agreed with the GM.

system.description: Craft and art of exceptional quality. Pay the Chi once per creative project.
